quarterly_data.quarter: Wacker Chemie press release: WACKER successfully completes sale of shares in Siltronic (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Wacker Chemie placed approximately 2.2 million Siltronic AG shares with qualified and institutional investors, 6.7 percent of Siltronic's capital stock, reducing its shareholding in Siltronic to approximately 15 percent; Wacker remains a significant shareholder. CEO Christian Hartel: 'We remain very satisfied with Siltronic's development and continue to support the company's strategy.'
